description: Social inbox DM conversations for Instagram and Facebook Page inboxes (Threads has no DMs; Pro plan or higher plus posts:read). Without conversation_id: list conversations filtered by account, platform, unread/starred/archived, or search, with limit/offset paging. With conversation_id: one conversation and its messages; there limit is the number of messages (default 50, max 100) and only workspace_id may be added.

conversation_id.description: One conversation (from a list call) with its messages.

filter.description: Conversation filter. Defaults to all (excludes archived).

limit.description: Conversations to return, or messages with conversation_id. Default 50, max 100.

offset.description: Skip this many conversations before returning results.

platform.description: instagram or facebook. Threads has no DMs.

search.description: Search participant username or last message preview.

workspace_id.description: Optional. Omit to search every workspace you belong to; pass a workspace ID from whoami to limit to one.

name: list_conversations
